meta.name: Life Sahi Hai
meta.description: Life Sahi Hai' is a sitcom that revolves around the lives of four guys who have moved to Delhi to live independently for the first time. They have a tendency to land in uncomfortable and what for us are hilarious, situations all the time. While dealing with bosses, girlfriends and with each other, these guys end up in such challenging situations, which only they are capable of landing themselves in. While they are getting used to the newfound freedom, they realize that freedom isn't free.[3] But despite all this, they can see the lighter side of life in everything, and keep believing that 'Life Sahi Hai'

videos.title: The Roommate
videos.overview: As Amit and Jasjit face eviction from their building, they hurry to find a perfect replacement for Siddharth and Sahil. After meeting a few prospects, they zero down on Vaibhav, who seems to be simple and sober, just what the boys were looking for.

videos.title: The Rival
videos.overview: Jasjit visits his mother and Vaibhav accompanies him. Out there Jasjit meets his childhood rival Amandeep, while Vaibhav tries to crack an idea for a life insurance ad campaign. Meanwhile, Amit is excited to meet his college friend Vicky who unfortunately had a bad breakup.

videos.title: The Cricket Match
videos.overview: It’s cricket finals and the boys decide to skip all work and cheer for India, but Amit’s girlfriend wants to go shopping. Meanwhile, Jasjit has switched to a healthy lifestyle to impress his new girlfriend but a surprise awaits him. Besides, Vaibhav has finally been set up on his first date ever, but will things go as planned?

videos.title: The Start Up
videos.overview: Jasjit bluffs to his ex-girlfriend that he is running a successful start-up but faces the risk of public humiliation when she sets up a meeting with her investor husband. Besides, Vaibhav is recovering from a heartache while Amit is setting himself up for one.

videos.title: The Performance
videos.overview: Amit plans to propose his girlfriend but finds himself going through a rough patch in his performance. On the other hand, Jasjit ensures that he remains fertile and does everything possible to keep himself active. Meanwhile, Vaibhav is left to take care of a child who makes life hell for him and the problem escalates even further when cops coming knocking at their door.
